title: Site Specification
description: Schema for site-spec.json — the single source of truth that the Architect produces and the Builder consumes to generate the Astro website.

$schema.description: Optional self-referencing JSON Schema URI so editors can validate site-spec.json automatically.

meta.description: Metadata about the specification itself: who it is for, which version, and when it was created or updated. Required so the Orchestrator can track iterations.

clientName.description: Human-readable name of the client or business. Used in headings, logs, and eject handoff.

version.description: Semver or iteration label of this spec. Helps the Orchestrator detect drift between spec and build.

createdAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of first creation. Used for audit trail and client reporting.

updatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of last modification. Lets the Orchestrator know if the spec changed since last build.

brand.description: Visual identity of the business. Drives Tailwind config, component theming, and favicon selection.

name.description: Official brand name. Used as default alt text, <title> fallback, and footer credit.

tagline.description: Short brand slogan displayed in the hero and metadata descriptions.

colors.description: Brand color palette mapped to Tailwind CSS custom properties. Each value must be a 6-digit hex code.

primary.description: Main brand color used for CTAs, links, and key UI elements.

secondary.description: Supporting color for secondary actions, accents, and hover states.

accent.description: Highlight color for badges, notifications, and emphasis elements.

background.description: Default page background color. Sets the base canvas for all sections.

text.description: Default body text color. Must meet WCAG contrast against the background.

typography.description: Font configuration for headings and body text. Maps to @font-face imports and Tailwind font-family utilities.

heading.description: Font family for h1–h6 elements. Typically a display or serif font.

body.description: Font family for paragraphs and UI text. Typically a sans-serif for readability.

logo.description: Logo asset references. Used in the header, footer, and as the OG image fallback.

src.description: Path or URL to the primary logo (light background variant).

dark.description: Optional path or URL to a dark-mode variant of the logo.

site.description: Site-wide configuration that affects routing, SEO, localization, and deployment targets.

domain.description: Production domain (e.g. example.com). Used to build canonical URLs and sitemap entries.

locale.description: BCP-47 locale tag for the site. Controls date/number formatting and default lang attribute.

language.description: ISO 639-1 language code. Sets the HTML lang attribute and influences SEO hreflang tags.

defaultTitle.description: Fallback <title> used on pages that do not define their own title.

defaultDescription.description: Fallback meta description used on pages that do not define their own description.

favicon.description: Path to the favicon file. Injected into the <head> of every page by the SEO component.

social.description: Social media / network links (RRSS) for the business. Each value is the full profile URL. Used in the footer and contact section.

pages.description: Ordered list of pages to generate. Each entry becomes a .astro file in src/pages/ and a route in the static output.

route.description: URL path for this page, must start with /. Determines the output file location in src/pages/.

title.description: Page-specific <title> override. Falls back to site.defaultTitle if omitted.

description.description: Page-specific meta description. Falls back to site.defaultDescription if omitted.

hero.description: Hero section configuration for the page. Controls the above-the-fold content: heading, subheading, CTA, and background.

sections.description: Ordered list of content sections to render below the hero. Each item defines a component block.

features.description: Toggleable platform features. Controls which integrations are wired up during the build.

gtm_id.description: Google Tag Manager container ID. When present, injected as PUBLIC_GTM_ID env var and loaded in the SEO component.

ga4_id.description: Google Analytics 4 measurement ID. Optional; used if GTM is not configured or for direct GA integration.

has_contact_form.description: Whether to generate a functional contact form page. If false, only static contact info is shown.

contact_channels.description: Which contact channels to display on the contact section/page. Each boolean toggles a specific channel UI.

map.description: Show embedded map (e.g. Google Maps iframe) for physical location.

dark_mode.description: Enable dark mode toggle. When true, Tailwind dark: variants and a theme switcher are included.

i18n.description: Internationalization configuration. Controls multi-language routing and content negotiation.

enabled.description: Whether i18n routing is active. When true, pages are generated under /<locale>/ prefixes.

defaultLocale.description: Default locale used when no prefix is present in the URL.

locales.description: List of supported locale codes. Each generates a routed subdirectory when i18n is enabled.

seo.description: Global SEO defaults passed as props to the immutable SEO.astro component.

defaultImage.description: Path or URL to the default Open Graph / Twitter card image used when a page does not define its own.

robots.description: Custom robots meta content (e.g. 'index, follow'). Overrides the default for all pages.

content_collections.description: Keystatic CMS content collection definitions for Phase 3. Each key is a collection name; the value defines its schema and fields. Kept open to allow arbitrary collection shapes.

additionalProperties.description: A single content collection definition. Name is derived from the object key.
